lines.en: label day240:
scene utaintro3
: Okay, Uta. Any final questions before you introduce yourself to the rest of class?
lines.zh: : 好了，Uta。在向全班自我介绍之前，你还有最后什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes. What time is lunch? I’m starving.
lines.zh: : 有。什么时候吃午饭？我饿死了。

lines.en: : School literally just started. Didn’t you eat breakfast?
lines.zh: : 才刚开学啊。你没吃早饭吗？

lines.en: : I was so excited to meet everyone that I forgot breakfast was even a thing.
lines.zh: : 我太兴奋了，兴奋到完全忘了世界上还有早饭这回事。

lines.en: : I’m going to need you to tone it down a bit. You’re too happy for this time of day.
lines.zh: : 我需要你稍微收敛一点。这个点儿你太开心了。

lines.en: : No can do, Sensei. Oh, another question-
lines.zh: : 这我做不到，Sensei。哦，还有一个问题——

lines.en: : I still haven’t moved into my dorm yet. Do you have any idea when that’s going to happen?
lines.zh: : 我还没搬进宿舍呢。您知道大概什么时候能搬吗？

lines.en: : I’m trying to avoid sleeping in an alleyway tonight if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我今晚尽量不想睡在巷子里。

lines.en: : During the summer it would be fine.
lines.zh: : 夏天的话倒无所谓。

lines.en: : I used to go camping all the time when I lived in the country, but a girl my size would probably die if I slept out in the snow.
lines.zh: : 我以前住在乡下的时候经常去露营，但我这种体型的女孩要是睡在雪地里，大概会死。

lines.en: : Talk to Makoto about that.
lines.zh: : 这件事你去找 Makoto。

lines.en: : Which one is Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto 是哪一个？

lines.en: : The one that looks like a student council president. You’ll know when you see her.
lines.zh: : 就是看起来像学生会长的那个。你一见就知道。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Anything else, then?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Are you and Maya {i}really{/i} not boyfriend and girlfriend? Cause I’ve got an eye for that sort of thing and I can just {i}feel{/i} the love.
lines.zh: : 有。您和 Maya {i}真的{/i}不是男女朋友吗？因为我对这种事眼光很准，我能{i}感觉{/i}到那股爱意。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll feel the same thing about my relationship with pretty much everyone in no time.
lines.zh: : 我相信你很快就会对我和几乎所有人的关系产生同样的感觉。

lines.en: scene utaintro2
: Ah! So there {i}is{/i} some back-scratching going on here!
lines.zh: : 啊！所以这里{i}真的{/i}有那种「互相挠背」的事啊！

lines.en: : I’ve gotta go call my parents and let them know the time has finally come for their little girl to become a woman!
lines.zh: : 我得去给爸妈打个电话，告诉他们他们的小女儿终于要变成女人了！

lines.en: : Can we get your intro out of the way first before you go and jeopardize my livelihood?
lines.zh: : 能不能先把自我介绍搞定，再去砸我的饭碗？

lines.en: scene utaintro3
: Oh, right. That’s what we were doing.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我们本来是在干这个。

lines.en: : Sorry, just having so much fun hanging out here in the hallway with you that I forgot I was even in[school] for a second.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，跟您在走廊上待着太开心了，我有一瞬间都忘了自己是在[school]里。

lines.en: : So, if that’s everything-
lines.zh: : 那么，如果没别的了——

lines.en: : Oh! One more thing!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有一件事！

lines.en: : Another? How many questions can you possibly have?
lines.zh: : 还有一个？你到底能有多少问题？

lines.en: : Do I look good in glasses?
lines.zh: : 我戴眼镜好看吗？

lines.en: : People always used to make fun of me because they made my eyes look huge or something and I don’t want everyone to think I’m some kinda bug-eyed Kansai freak.
lines.zh: : 以前大家都笑话我，说戴上眼镜眼睛显得特别大什么的，我不想让所有人都觉得我是个从关西来的凸眼怪胎。

lines.en: : You look as adorable as ever.
lines.zh: : 你还是和以前一样可爱。

lines.en: scene utaintro4
: As ever? Did little old Uta-chan leave such a good impression on you that she’s been forever stapled into your brain as the ideal girl?
lines.zh: : 和以前一样？难道小小的 Uta 给您留下的印象好到已经被永远钉在您脑子里，当成理想女孩了？

lines.en: : Or, better yet, the ideal woman?
lines.zh: : 或者说，更准确点，理想的女人？

lines.en: : But Sensei, it’s so soon. We barely even know each other. I’m not ready for such a big leap yet.
lines.zh: : 可是 Sensei，这也太快了。我们才刚认识。我还没准备好跨出这么大一步呢。

lines.en: : You were about to call your parents and tell them you were going to become a woman just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前还准备打电话告诉爸妈你要变成女人了。

lines.en: scene utaintro5
: You were gonna make me a woman in front of the whole class?! Sensei! That’s so lewd!
lines.zh: : 您是要在全班面前把我变成女人吗？！Sensei！这太下流了！

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong, I’m all about dating someone older and stronger and cooler than me, but {i}in front of everyone else{/i}? That’s just too much!
lines.zh: : 别误会，我也很想交个比我年长、比我强壮、比我酷的男朋友，但{i}当着所有人的面{/i}？这太过了！

lines.en: : Keep your voice down, please...
lines.zh: : 麻烦你小声点……

lines.en: scene utaintro6
: OH GOD HE’S ALREADY SICK OF ME! I CAME ON TOO STRONG AGAIN!
lines.zh: : 天哪他已经烦死我了！我又一次表现得太急着贴上去啦！

lines.en: : UTA USHIBORI’S DAYS AS A NORMAL HIGH SCHOOL MAID ARE OVER!
lines.zh: : UTA USHIBORI 当普通高中女仆的日子已经结束了！

lines.en: : I SHOULD HAVE STAYED IN NARA AND MARRIED A DEER!
lines.zh: : 我当初就该留在 NARA 嫁给一头鹿的！

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Day-one of transfers and you've already lost control?
lines.zh: : 转学第一天，你就已经控制不住局面了？

lines.en: Wakana pulls open her door and peeks her head out just far enough to slight me for being unable to control Uta.
lines.zh: Wakana 拉开门，只探出个脑袋，刚好够为「我管不住 Uta」这件事数落我两句。

lines.en: : Just be happy I got this one instead of you.
lines.zh: : 你就庆幸这个分给了我而不是你吧。

lines.en: : UTA USHIBORI ISN’T EVEN A GIRL ANYMORE! SHE’S JUST “THIS ONE!”
lines.zh: : UTA USHIBORI 已经连女生都不算了！她只是「这个」！

lines.en: : Uta, please...Let’s just go inside and introduce you to everyone else.
lines.zh: : Uta，拜托……我们先进去，把你介绍给其他人吧。

lines.en: : I HOPE THE STUDENTS ARE DEER!
lines.zh: : 我希望学生们都是鹿！

lines.en: : Please calm your {i}miscreant{/i} down, {i}Sensei{/i}...I’m trying to actually do my job over here.
lines.zh: : 请您管管您的{i}问题儿童{/i}，{i}Sensei{/i}……我这边的课还得上呢。

lines.en: : I’ve got it, Wakana...
lines.zh: : 我搞得定，Wakana……

lines.en: : Uta, they’re normal [high_school] girls just like you.
lines.zh: : Uta，她们是和你一样的普通[high_school]女生。

lines.en: scene utaintro7
: Normal?...
: So...not deer?...
lines.zh: : 所以……不是鹿？……

lines.en: : Not deer.
lines.zh: : 不是鹿。

lines.en: : Hah...
: I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: Wakana disappears back into her classroom and probably dumps a bunch of dead animals into a cauldron or something.
lines.zh: Wakana 缩回她的教室，大概去往坩埚里扔一堆动物尸体什么的了。

lines.en: She looks like the type who would do that.
lines.zh: 她看着就像干得出这种事的人。

lines.en: scene black
I wind up calming Uta down after another minute or two and she finally agrees to go meet everyone else.
lines.zh: 又过了一两分钟，我总算把 Uta 安抚下来，她终于同意去见见其他人。

lines.en: She regains her composure rather quickly and skips into the classroom, stopping right at my desk and turning to face the class without even writing her name on the board.
lines.zh: 她很快就恢复了镇定，蹦蹦跳跳地进了教室，在我的讲桌前站定，转过身面对全班，连名字都没往黑板上写。

lines.en: scene utaintro8
: Hm? Isn’t that the girl from the maid cafe?
lines.zh: : 嗯？那不是女仆咖啡店的那个女生吗？

lines.en: : What’s she doing here?
lines.zh: : 她在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : She must be...part of all the transfer students coming to our[school] instead now.
lines.zh: : 她一定是……现在改来我们[school]的转学生之一。

lines.en: : Holy heck, I think she’s even shorter than me!
lines.zh: : 我去，她好像比我还矮！

lines.en: : I’m not actually...tall...am I?
lines.zh: : 我其实……不算高……对吧？

lines.en: : Yeaaaaah I don’t think so, Miku. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 呃——我可不这么觉得，Miku。抱歉。

lines.en: : Why do all of the girls our age have such nice legs?
lines.zh: : 为什么和我们同龄的女生腿都那么好看？

lines.en: : I’ve been wondering that ever since I was little, Tsuneyo. I feel ya.
lines.zh: : 我从小就在想这个问题了，Tsuneyo。我懂你。

lines.en: scene utaintro9
: Do you also get the urge to touch them or am I just broken?
lines.zh: : 您也会有想摸摸看的冲动吗，还是说只有我不正常？

lines.en: : If wanting to touch girls means you’re broken, I never want to be fixed.
lines.zh: : 如果想摸女生就是不正常，那我永远都不想被治好。

lines.en: scene utaintro10
: Really? Another one? Our class is already fucking packed.
lines.zh: : 真的假的？又来一个？我们班已经他妈的够挤了。

lines.en: : Yumi, only like, half of the desks are occupied.
lines.zh: : Yumi，其实只有一半左右的座位有人坐。

lines.en: : And why do you care in the first place? You never even come here.
lines.zh: : 而且你到底在乎什么？你根本就不来上课。

lines.en: : Still my fuckin’ classroom. Been wanting to come even less since Ireland and Noodles showed up.
lines.zh: : 那也是老子的教室。自从爱尔兰人和面条妹来了之后，我就更不想来了。

lines.en: scene utaintro11
: Sure you’re not just jealous that it’s going to get even harder for you to grab Sensei’s attention?
lines.zh: : 你该不会只是嫉妒吧？毕竟以后你想抢到 Sensei 的注意力就更难了。

lines.en: : The fuck are you talkin’ about? I’m like the only one {i}not{/i} trying to do that shit.
lines.zh: : 你他妈在说什么？我大概是唯一一个{i}不{/i}想搞那套的人。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t {i}you{/i} be the one freaking out if that’s the case?
lines.zh: : 要真是这样，该抓狂的人不是{i}你{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene utaintro12
: I have no idea what you’re talking about~
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么~

lines.en: : And even if I did, there’s no way Sensei would be into someone that tiny.
lines.zh: : 就算我知道，Sensei 也不可能喜欢那么小一只的。

lines.en: : He clearly likes more {i}mature{/i} girls. Ones that can stand on their own two feet, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 他明显更喜欢{i}成熟{/i}的女生。那种能自立的，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : More like ones that can lay on their back and take-
lines.zh: : 更像是能躺下承受的那种吧——

lines.en: scene utaintro13
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : I didn’t say anythin’.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没说。

lines.en: scene utaintro14
: Hi everybody! My name’s Uta Ushibori and I just transferred in from Kumon-mi Academy after it sunk into the ground!
lines.zh: : 大家好！我叫 Uta Ushibori，刚刚从 Kumon-mi Academy 转来，因为那所学校沉到地里去了！

lines.en: Oh, so we’re [kumon_mi_high] and the other[school] was Kumon-mi Academy. That’s not confusing at all.
lines.zh: 哦，所以我们是 [kumon_mi_high]，另一所[school]是 Kumon-mi Academy。这一点都不让人困惑呢。

lines.en: : I came here from Nara a couple years ago to take care of my grandpa.
lines.zh: : 我几年前从 Nara 来这儿，是为了照顾我爷爷。

lines.en: : Wait, really? I didn’t know that...
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？我都不知道……

lines.en: scene utaintro15
: Oh! Ami’s here! Hi, Ami!
lines.zh: : 哦！Ami 也在！你好呀，Ami！

lines.en: : Hahaha...hey...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……你好啊……

lines.en: scene utaintro14
: Anyway, my grandpa died last year and I obviously don’t have to take care of him anymore as a result.
lines.zh: : 总之，我爷爷去年去世了，所以我显然不用再照顾他了。

lines.en: : But I obviously can’t go home either because they closed off Kumon-mi, so now I just spend my time working at a maid cafe and shopping!
lines.zh: : 但我显然也回不了家，因为 Kumon-mi 被封了，所以我现在就是一边在女仆咖啡店打工，一边逛街！

lines.en: : Umm...what else...what else?
lines.zh: : 呃……还有什么……还有什么？

lines.en: : Oh yeah! Being born in the country has kinda made it so I can like...share too much or be too...umm, what’s the word...intrusive at times?
lines.zh: : 哦对了！因为在乡下长大，我有时候会……说得太多，或者太……呃，那个词怎么说……太没分寸？

lines.en: : For example, if I ever find out anyone likes anyone else, I’ll probs spill the beans accidentally. Please don’t hate me when that happens.
lines.zh: : 比如说，我要是知道了谁喜欢谁，大概会不小心说漏嘴。到时候请别讨厌我。

lines.en: scene utaintro16
: Um...Is that good enough for an intro? I’m running outta steam here.
lines.zh: : 呃……这样当自我介绍够了吗？我快没劲儿了。

lines.en: : I’ve suddenly forgotten everything interesting about myself.
lines.zh: : 我突然想不起自己身上有什么有意思的地方了。

lines.en: : Can you do the thing?
lines.zh: : 你能来一下那个吗？

lines.en: scene utaintro17
: The thing?...
: You mean the Uta-chan thing? The thing that makes boys’ and girls’ hearts melt out of their chest?
lines.zh: : 您是说 Uta 的那个？那个能让男生女生的心从胸口化掉的？

lines.en: : Are you really sure it’s okay?
lines.zh: : 您真的确定可以吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know if it will have the same impact without my uniform on.
lines.zh: : 我没穿制服的话，不知道效果还一不一样。

lines.en: scene utaintro18
: The thing? She doesn’t mean {i}that{/i} thing, does she?...
lines.zh: : 那个？她该不会是指那个{i}「那个」{/i}吧？……

lines.en: : What other {i}thing{/i} could she possibly mean?
lines.zh: : 她还能是指别的{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Also, why’s she all chummy with Sensei?
lines.zh: : 还有，她为什么跟 Sensei 那么亲热？

lines.en: : I know he’s spent millions of Yen on her but she’s not even in maid-mode right now.
lines.zh: : 我知道他在她身上花了几百万日元，可她现在又没穿女仆装。

lines.en: : I’m much cuter than her outside of the cafe. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 在咖啡店外面，我比她可爱多了。对吧，Maya？

lines.en: : Right, Ami. You’re the cutest ever. No one can compete.
lines.zh: : 对，Ami。你是全世界最可爱的。没人比得上。

lines.en: : Thank you, Maya. I love you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Maya。我爱你。

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: scene utaintro19
: Well, uhh...I guess since the teacher asked me to do this, I can’t possibly say no.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……既然是老师让我做的，我总不好拒绝吧。

lines.en: scene utaintro20
: {i}Ahem...{/i}
I have to admit, I didn’t think she’d actually go for it in front of the entire class.
lines.zh: 我得承认，我没想到她真会在全班面前来这一套。

lines.en: But the way I look at it, what Uta is about to do will either make or break her[school] life.
lines.zh: 但在我看来，Uta 接下来要做的事，要么成就她的[school]生活，要么毁掉它。

lines.en: Let’s hope her power is strong enough to capture all of the girls' hearts the way it captured mine.
lines.zh: 但愿她的力量足够强，能像俘获我一样俘获所有女生的心。

lines.en: scene utaintro21
: FLAVOR...BEEEEEAAAAAAAAAAM!!!!!!!!!!
scene utaintro22
: So much...power...
lines.zh: : 好强的……力量……

lines.en: : I can feel the flavor from all the way over here!
lines.zh: : 我在这么远的地方都能感觉到那股美味！

lines.en: : I don’t feel any different.
lines.zh: : 我没觉得有什么不同。

lines.en: : I feel...light-headed...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……有点头晕……

lines.en: scene utaintro23
: I am now delicious.
lines.zh: : 我现在变得很美味了。

lines.en: scene utaintro24
: Oh...my...fucking...god...
: Yumi, you should do that for Chinami’s scrambled eggs one day. She’d love it.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你哪天也该给 Chinami 的炒蛋来一下。她肯定会喜欢的。

lines.en: : I’d rather fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿去死。

lines.en: scene utaintro25
: What’s this? A non-believer in our midst?
lines.zh: : 这是怎么了？我们当中还有个不信的人？

lines.en: : Let me guess, you’re the class delinquent? The real {i}tough{/i} one that nobody messes with?
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜，你就是班上的不良少女？那个没人敢惹的{i}狠{/i}角色？

lines.en: : Guess so. What’s it to you, flavor-{i}bitch{/i}?
lines.zh: : 算是吧。关你屁事，美味{i}婊{/i}？

lines.en: : Come on, Yumi. That was just upsetting.
lines.zh: : 别这样，Yumi。这话也太伤人了。

lines.en: : Fuck off, Chika.
lines.zh: : 滚一边去，Chika。

lines.en: : Hmm...I see, I see. You {i}do{/i} appear to be rather intimidating. But Uta Ushibori does not shy away from bullies!
lines.zh: : 嗯……我懂了，我懂了。你看起来{i}确实{/i}挺吓人的。但 Uta Ushibori 绝不会在恶霸面前退缩！

lines.en: : So what? You trying to fight or some shit? That what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你想打架还是怎么的？就这意思？

lines.en: : Yes! No! Sort of!
lines.zh: : 是！不是！差不多吧！

lines.en: : I challenge you to an arm wrestling match! The loser needs to stop bullying everyone for the rest of eternity!
lines.zh: : 我要跟你比掰手腕！输的人从此以后永远不许再欺负任何人！

lines.en: : No more bad names! No more making fun of beams designed to warm hearts!
lines.zh: : 不许再骂人！不许再嘲笑那种用来温暖人心的光波！

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And when I win, what do I get?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那我赢了有什么好处？

lines.en: scene utaintro26
: I will never cast my spell in class again...
lines.zh: : 我以后再也不在课上施法了……

lines.en: Oh no. Anything but that.
lines.zh: 哦不。千万别是那个。

lines.en: : Fine. I’m in. Let’s do this shit.
lines.zh: : 行。我奉陪。来吧。

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, I’m kinda rooting for Uta here.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还挺想给 Uta 加油的。

lines.en: scene utaintro27
: For once in my life, I am proud to say that I am not the center of attention.
lines.zh: : 这辈子难得有一次，我可以骄傲地说，我不是众人目光的焦点。

lines.en: : This is a huge victory for Molly MacCormack.
lines.zh: : 这对 Molly MacCormack 来说是一场巨大的胜利。

lines.en: : I wonder who’s going to win? I’d normally say Yumi but...Uta might have some kind of hidden country-girl strength or something?
lines.zh: : 我在想谁会赢？我本来会说 Yumi，但……Uta 说不定有什么隐藏的乡下怪力之类的？

lines.en: : Yes, yes. I, too, possess the hidden power of my ancestors.
lines.zh: : 没错，没错。我也拥有来自祖先的隐藏力量。

lines.en: : You sure you want to do this? I ain’t holdin’ anything back, FYI.
lines.zh: : 你确定要来？先说好，我可不会手下留情。

lines.en: : Of course. Like I said, Uta Ushibori doesn’t let bullies be bullies!
lines.zh: : 当然。就像我说的，Uta Ushibori 绝不放任恶霸作恶！

lines.en: : Your days of crime are over...umm...ummm...
lines.zh: : 你作恶的日子到头了……呃……呃……

lines.en: : Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: : Your days of crime are over, Yumi!
lines.zh: : 你作恶的日子到头了，Yumi！

lines.en: : Someone! Count us down!
lines.zh: : 谁来个人！给我们倒数！

lines.en: scene utaintro28
: Oh! Uhh...
: Three...
: Two...
: One...
scene utaintro29
: GO!
lines.zh: : 开始！

lines.en: scene utaintro30
: AHHHHH!!! LET GO! LET GO! LET GO!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！！！松手！松手！松手！

lines.en: : Alas...evil has triumphed once again...
lines.zh: : 唉……邪恶又一次得逞了……

lines.en: : So, you’re done with all that flavor beam shit now, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，你那套美味光波的破玩意儿到此为止了，对吧？

lines.en: : I WILL NOT...BE BULLIED!
lines.zh: : 我绝不会……被欺负！

lines.en: scene utaintro31
: Hey! We had a fuckin’ deal!
lines.zh: : 喂！我们可是说好了的！

lines.en: : I won! So try that beam shit again and I’ll fuck up your other arm, too!
lines.zh: : 我赢了！你再敢来那套光波，我就把你另一只手也废了！

lines.en: : Jesus, Yumi, let go! You’re going to break the poor girl’s wrist!
lines.zh: : 天哪，Yumi，松手！你要把这可怜女孩的手腕掰断了！

lines.en: : FINE! NO MORE FLAVOR BEAM IN CLASS!
lines.zh: : 行吧！课上再也不用美味光波了！

lines.en: : BUT...LET IT BE KNOWN! I WAS ONLY DOING...AS I WAS TOLD!
lines.zh: : 但是……请大家记住！我只是……奉命行事！

lines.en: : YOU HAVE NOT...SEEN THE LAST...OF UTA-CHAN!
lines.zh: : 你们还没有……见到 UTA 的最后一面！

lines.en: scene black
The[school] day ended with me taking Uta to the nurse.
lines.zh: 这一天的[school]生活结束时，是我把 Uta 送去了医务室。

lines.en: Thankfully, there was no break or fracture or anything like that. She just pulled a muscle from how suddenly Yumi pinned her arm down.
lines.zh: 万幸没有骨折之类的伤，只是 Yumi 猛地把手压下去时拉伤了肌肉。

lines.en: I have to say, it was kind of depressing seeing her lose after how much she hyped herself up.
lines.zh: 我得说，看她把自己捧得那么高最后却输了，还挺让人沮丧的。

lines.en: For a moment, it seemed like she had the potential to be the class hero.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，她看起来是有成为班级英雄的潜力的。

lines.en: Unfortunately, the days of the flavor beam are now gone.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，美味光波的时代就此终结。

lines.en: At least in[school], that is.
lines.zh: 至少在[school]里是这样。

lines.en: I have every intention of abusing that hidden power of hers each and every time I go to the maid cafe.
lines.zh: 至于每次去女仆咖啡店，我可是打算把她的隐藏力量用个够。

$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
